info.title: SkyShift X API
info.description:
Contract between the SkyShift X frontend and the scientific/AI backend. GENERATED from src/contracts/v1 (Zod) by `pnpm gen:api`; do not edit by hand.

Rules: every 2xx body is `{ apiVersion, data, meta }`; every non-2xx body is `{ apiVersion, error: { code, message, details? } }`. `meta.simulated` must be true whenever any value in the response is synthetic. Image URLs may be absolute or relative to the API base URL. The backend performs all alignment, subtraction, detection and measurement; the frontend only displays results.

post.summary: Ask a question in context and receive a narrated journey
post.description: The AI backend generates a Journey from the question and the selected source/evidence. If it cannot, it must answer 422 with code `unsupported_in_demo` or `unavailable`; the frontend shows that message and never invents a journey.
